display_title: I Just Went for a Health Checkup
description:
“There’s so much semen in your vagina that it’s going to be difficult to examine you. I think I’ll have to remove the semen before I can insert the instrument.”

Jia went in for a health checkup, where she was scheduled to undergo a breast ultrasound and a cervical cancer screening, but the doctors’ gazes as they looked at her were sinister!

“Those tits… wow… they’re quite something. They make me want to keep touching them.”

Jia just wanted this humiliating exam to end quickly.

An empty ultrasound room. Standing naked in front of a doctor in a crisp white coat, the thought of her breasts being touched made her head spin.

“Uh, Dr. Seo…”

The more they were touched, the more her nipples stood erect, oblivious to the shame. Min-jun was just doing his job as a doctor. Ji-ah felt embarrassed that she was harboring such lewd feelings.

“I’m just making a diagnosis as a doctor, so there’s no need to feel embarrassed.”
